name: winvibe-agent
description: Windows 桌面端专为 Claude Code 及各类 AI 编程 Agent 打造的原生悬浮灵动岛控制台

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node --test dist-electron/sessionRegistry.test.js dist-electron/core/SessionHub.test.js dist-electron/core/OASP.test.js dist-electron/adapters/adapters.test.js
scripts.start: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(f=>{f.copyFileSync('electron/preload.cjs','dist-electron/preload.cjs');if(f.existsSync('electron/tray-icon.png'))f.copyFileSync('electron/tray-icon.png','dist-electron/tray-icon.png');})" && node scripts/launch.js electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "node scripts/launch.js vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run electron:dev"
scripts.electron:dev: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(f=>{f.copyFileSync('electron/preload.cjs','dist-electron/preload.cjs');if(f.existsSync('electron/tray-icon.png'))f.copyFileSync('electron/tray-icon.png','dist-electron/tray-icon.png');})" && node scripts/launch.js electron . --dev
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(f=>{f.copyFileSync('electron/preload.cjs','dist-electron/preload.cjs');if(f.existsSync('electron/tray-icon.png'))f.copyFileSync('electron/tray-icon.png','dist-electron/tray-icon.png');})"
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/launch.js npx electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.package:exe: npm run build && node scripts/launch.js npx electron-builder --win portable
